title: The Reset Block (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop-folk 98 bpm calming acoustic guitar warm bass soft snare hand claps mellow flute light Spanish phrase accent steady drilling cadence pickleball training song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fast ball coming hands stay soft
Deaden the pace let it loft
Elbow in paddle relaxed and low
Reset the rally back to slow

[Pre-Chorus]
Reset reset reset reset
Soft hands save the set
Reset reset reset reset
Drop it in no sweat

[Chorus]
This is the reset block soft and short
Take the heat off bring it to court
Reset reset reset reset land it in the kitchen
Reset reset reset reset cool the friction cool the friction

[Verse 2]
Knees bent paddle face open
Let the ball hit absorb the motion
No swing no swing just a cushion stop
The pace is gone let it drop

[Bridge]
When the speedup comes your way
Soft hands always win the day
Block and reset block and reset
Calm hands keep your seat

[Outro]
Reset reset reset soft and low
Reset reset reset cool and slow
